example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from qwiic_keypad import QwiicKeypad
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
kp = QwiicKeypad(i2c)
i2c.writeto(0x4B, bytes([0x00, 0x99]))  # read-only id: ignored
print('ID=%02X %s' % (kp._read(0x00), kp.version()))
time.sleep(2)
while True:
    kp.update_fifo()
    b = kp.button()
    if b:
        print('KEY=%s' % chr(b))
    time.sleep_ms(100)

test.title: key events come out in order
